title: You are always in control
subtitle: Switch BOS on and off as needed.

website.intro: Choose the help you want from the BOS page in your app. Turn Local BOS and Cloud BOS on or off independently.

controls.name: Local BOS
controls.description: Build guidance and stability checks stored in your app.

controls.name: Cloud BOS
controls.description: Connected scans, specialist knowledge and build guidance.

website.reassurance: Pausing BOS does not switch off your app’s login, permissions or data protection.
website.timing: Your builder applies your saved choice on its next request.

onboarding.title: Choose when BOS helps
onboarding.text: After setup, open the BOS page in your app. Use the Local BOS and Cloud BOS switches to pause or resume either kind of assistance. Your builder applies the change on its next request. Your app’s login, permissions and data protection stay in place.
onboarding.access_note: These controls are available to app administrators.
